Dated: March 31, 2026
Certificate of Completion of Work
This is to certify that the work of “Ring Road — Maharashtra Pkg-125” (expressways), awarded to
M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been
completed in all respects on March 1, 2010 at a gross executed value of INR 52,99,00,000/- (Rupees
52.99 Crore Only).
The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on
satisfactory completion of the final inspection.
The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Rahul Menon. This certificate is issued for record
and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
performance.
Executive Engineer
Public Works Department, Govt of Maharashtra
